list: The official 55 trophies, 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze, 28 hidden
note: Names, descriptions and grades are the official list as published on PlayStation and tracked by Exophase and PSNProfiles. Guides are written in our own words; each cites its sources.

trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one pops on its own. There is no shortcut: the road runs through the full story, 100% completion, and every side activity in Leonida. Expect around 200 hours, and treat A Long Road as the real final boss — everything else is a step toward it.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, to the end. It is unmissable story progress and usually the first trophy most players earn — just follow the mission as it plays out.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 1. Before the chapter ends, do the one thing in the whole list that can be missed: Lucia's balcony meditation (see Positive Mental Attitude). Keep a manual save from the start of the chapter until that trophy pops.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 2. This is the chapter where the game opens up: after Breakfast Run you can switch between Jason and Lucia, which unlocks the partner trophies, so start using the duo as soon as switching is available.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 3. One warning inside this chapter: the Race Against Yago in Yago's street-racing strand is time-sensitive — it carries an hourglass icon and counts toward Strangers & Freaks, so save first and race the moment it appears.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 4. Bank vault robberies open up near the end of this chapter through an optional mission, so if you want Maximum Withdrawal done before the credits, take that mission when it shows up.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Finish the final story mission. Because there is no mission replay and no New Game Plus, keep an untouched manual save from just before the finale — it is your safety net for anything story-adjacent you still want to redo.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run early in Chapter 2. It matters beyond its own trophy: finishing it unlocks switching between Jason and Lucia, and the partner trophies all build on that.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. It pops from story progress alone — no special preparation, just play the mission through.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. Unmissable story progress — it unlocks as you play through the chapters.
trophies.name: Family Matters

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. Unmissable story progress — it unlocks as you play through the chapters.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown. Unmissable story progress — it unlocks as you play through the chapters.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. Unmissable story progress — it unlocks as you play through the chapters.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion — the hardest trophy on the list and the gate to the Platinum. The checklist only appears after the story, under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion, but work done earlier still counts. Its big items: 300 stunts, 70 of 80 Challenges, 200 of 277 vehicles, all 8 bank vaults and all 39 illegal operations. Do the missable meditation in Chapter 1 first, then clean up the rest at your own pace after the credits.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts across Leonida: stunt jumps, flights under bridges, knife flights and base jumps all count. Keep going past 250 — the 100% checklist wants 300, so every stunt you do now is progress twice over.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Sample each of the nine activity types once — fishing, racing, the shooting range, the arcade, bowling and the rest. It is a taster trophy: you do not need to master anything, just try everything once.
trophies.name: Master of None

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn gold medals in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, spread across two shooting ranges. Take it range by range and treat each challenge as its own small time trial — accuracy and speed both feed the medal.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. You only need one win per location, so move on as soon as each race is won and tick the map off location by location.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Variety is what counts — the same race won twice still counts once, so work through the race types across the map instead of grinding one favourite.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Challenge Cal to a fishing contest and beat him. Fishing is one of the nine activity types, so a win here also feeds Master of None — take it when the challenge appears and fish patiently rather than rushing the reel.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.guide: Finish any one arcade game — any of the four in-game games counts. Pick the one you find easiest and play it through to the end; you do not need a high score, just a completion.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Play through Andy's mission strand to its final mission and complete it. Side-story finales stay open after the main story ends, so there is no rush — but do not leave the strand half-finished, because only the finale pops the trophy.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Play through Kenton's mission strand to its final mission and complete it. Like the other side-story finales it stays available after the main story, so finish it whenever you are passing through.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Play through Billy's mission strand to its final mission and complete it. Side-story finales stay open after the main story ends, so this one can wait until your post-story cleanup.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands. Not every strand counts: Andy's, Billy's and Tyrone's have their own trophies and do not add to this total, so check the trophy's progress counter after each strand you finish. One strand to prioritise early is Yago's street racing in Chapter 3 — its race is time-sensitive, marked with an hourglass, so save first and race the moment it appears.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Play through Randy's mission strand to its final mission and complete it. Side-story finales stay open after the main story ends, so finish it during your cleanup pass.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Play through Tyrone's mission strand to its final mission and complete it. Side-story finales stay open after the main story ends, so finish it during your cleanup pass.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida. Spots show as purple icons when you are close. Outdoor spots count twice if you meditate there with both characters, so always bring your partner. THE MISSABLE ONE: Lucia's balcony meditation in Chapter 1 — after Lucia is home, check the kitchen in the morning (the morning after the mission Down to Earth is the usual time); she heads out to the balcony of Jason's house to meditate, so follow her and accept the optional task. It is gone once Chapter 1 ends, and there is no mission replay, so keep a Chapter 1 save until this trophy pops.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Follow Bret Vogel's hunting questline — it is Jason-only — and hunt the unique animal it sends you after, working through its target decks. A clean head or heart shot keeps the carcass pristine, which is what the hunt rewards.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete any 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida, so collect as you travel rather than hunting them all in one run — every set you finish brings the trophy closer.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK app at 100 locations across the map. Fold it into everything else you do: scan as you drive, and the same app also counts vehicles toward Whip It Good, so one habit feeds two trophies.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges, listed under Progress, then Challenges. Many complete on their own while you play, so check the list during cleanup and pick off the ones nearest done. The 100% checklist wants 70 of 80, so keep going past 50.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star Wanted Level and then lose it completely — the trophy only pops once you have left the red heat zone, not just the flashing search area. The easy route: bank vault jobs hand you a 4-star level straight away, so escape one with your partner and this pops alongside the robbery.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Call your partner, then rob three shops in a row while the police are still chasing you. If the stars fade and you are only in the red heat zone, the chain breaks — so keep moving and keep the heat on. The trophy can take about 30 seconds to pop after you leave the third shop, so give it a moment before hitting a fourth.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Scanning a vehicle with the WAiNK app counts as discovering it, so scan traffic as you drive instead of only counting what you steal. The 100% checklist wants 200 of the 277 base models, so the habit pays off twice.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Down 5 enemies during one use of Combat Focus — the slow-motion aim you trigger with L3 and R3 while aiming. Pick a group of gang enemies, such as the guards at an illegal operation, and use an assault rifle; adrenaline extends Focus, so chain your shots while it lasts.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: At Vice City International Airport, steal a large passenger plane that is docked at a boarding bridge — the planes at gates E3 and E4 work, while planes parked elsewhere on the airfield do not count. Get to the cockpit, back out toward the runway and take off. The pop is delayed: fly about 1 km away from the airport and it should trigger. Save first, because the police come fast.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Get into a military tank — a Rhino. Tanks are parked on the south side of Mile Zero Air Station, on the island at the far southwest of the map. Save first, climb in, and drive and fire until the trophy pops.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without anyone spotting you. The Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs gives you the Snap Gun and opens jewelry store robberies: go to a store's locked back door and use the Snap Gun on it — kicking the door in sets off the alarm. Inside the back room, find the note with the safe code, open the safe, and leave without being seen. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good target; if someone spots you, reload rather than push on.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. Vaults unlock through That's Where The Money Is, an optional mission near the end of Chapter 4: tail an armored security van to a large bank and get into the vault while the guard has it open. You cannot carry all the bags alone, so bring your partner — and since a vault job hands you a 4-star Wanted Level straight away, escaping one with your partner also earns Hot Together. The 100% checklist wants all 8 vaults, so keep robbing past 5.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Like the other robbery trophies, it only pops once you have left the red heat zone — getting clear of the flashing search area is not enough, so keep driving until the heat is fully gone.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore every named area of Leonida — 52 areas in all. This one fills in naturally as you travel for missions, races and collectibles; by the time you finish the story and the side strands, only a few out-of-the-way corners should be left to visit.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the nine gangs. The 100% checklist wants all 39 operations, so this trophy pops along the way while you work through them — vary your targets rather than hitting the same gang's spots twice.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Head to Ocean Beach, order a cocktail, and take in the view. It is a quiet moment trophy — no mission, no grind, just the right spot at the right time.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Drive a car straight out of a vehicle showroom, smashing through the glass in classic style. Pick your moment, build up speed inside, and go through the front — the trophy is about the exit, not the car.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: The Kolt & Associates bowling alley is Kingpin Bowling, an illegal operation you visit in Chapter 2. Bring Sticky Bombs and take all three key valuables: the luxury watch in an office, the shotgun on a table, and the contents of the office safe, which you blow open with a Sticky Bomb. Then escape the police. If you leave something behind, the operation comes back later, so it is not missable.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: Reach maximum Strength with both Jason and Lucia. Buy a gym membership and train with your partner there — they train alongside you, so both characters climb together instead of one at a time.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Make 500 choices that change your Criminal Profile. Robberies, fights and the decisions you make across Leonida all feed it, so it fills up without a separate grind — keep playing the way you already play and it lands on its own.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Succeed at something on your second try. It is a luck-of-the-moment trophy — fail a challenge or attempt once, then nail it on the retry and it pops.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.guide: Witness something strange out in Leonida. This is one of the hidden trophies whose exact unlock was still unconfirmed at launch, so treat it as a wander-and-see trophy: explore odd corners of the map and it should find you. Do not trust any single claimed method until a guide with a verified source confirms it.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle — a melee drive-by. The precise method was still being confirmed at launch, so take the description literally: line up a drive-by, swing a melee weapon from the vehicle, and connect.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from bank and payday loan jobs — sell them on to your contacts and the total is cumulative, so every job adds up. Bank vault runs are the richest source, so this pairs naturally with Maximum Withdrawal.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. The total is cumulative across every kind of shop, so it ticks up as you buy weapons, clothes, food and car parts through a normal playthrough — no need to blow it all in one place.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garage properties through the Vice City Real Estate app, which unlocks after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver. Together they cost about $160,000 — garages the story gives you do not count, so buy all eight yourself. Garages also matter for On the Spot, since each registered car needs a free space.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app. The Chapter 2 mission Moses opens the app: take a stolen car to Moses, choose Respray, then Register. From Chapter 3 you can also register cars with a standard tracker at Pay 'n' Spray. Each car needs a free garage space, so buy garages first and register cheap cars.
trophies.name: On the Spot
